name: The Old Fid

intro.text: They say there's a Fid still wintering on the ice, who got a bit lost in 1962 and has been here since. They are right. Come and meet me.

win: Ha! I'll remember that. I've a very good memory, for a man who isn't there.
after: They never found my bunk. They just stopped looking. That's the only way anyone has ever managed to be left alone.
